changes: New: Fire alarm certificates now include a Service History table on Page 3 — every previous inspection for the same property is automatically fetched and printed, showing date, certificate type, outcome, and reference number.
Fixed: Certificate outcome text now matches the cert type — FA.1 says 'Installation & commissioning complete', FA.2 says 'Annual service and inspection complete', etc.
Fixed: 'Requires Attention' outcome now shows an amber band on the certificate instead of red — only Unsatisfactory stays red.
Fixed: Previous Report Reference only appears on FA.2 periodic inspection certs, not on FA.1 installation certs.
